--- Mount & auth ---
/exam-sessions is mounted in app.js behind requireAuth + requireRole('LECTURER') on EVERY route. Unauthenticated requests get 401; non-LECTURER get 403. createApp accepts an `examSessionService` (and `examSessionRepository`, `ttsAdapter`) override for test injection. ttsAdapter is built via createTtsAdapter(runtimeEnv); env.ttsProvider added (TTS_PROVIDER, default 'mock').

--- Exact /exam-sessions route shapes (for FEAT-003) ---
All routes LECTURER-only (requireAuth + requireRole('LECTURER')). req.user={id,role} threaded controller->service.
- POST   /exam-sessions                 create
- GET    /exam-sessions                 list (scope-filtered: ADMIN all; LECTURER own + in-scope subjects)
- GET    /exam-sessions/:id             getById (returns session + participants)
- PUT    /exam-sessions/:id             update (DRAFT-only)
- PUT    /exam-sessions/:id/students    setStudents (roster)
- PUT    /exam-sessions/:id/examiners   setExaminers
- POST   /exam-sessions/:id/open        open
- POST   /exam-sessions/:id/close       close

--- Request/response bodies ---
POST /exam-sessions request: { subjectId (int, required, in-scope), topicId (int, required, must belong to subject), title?, language ('VI'|'EN', required), main_question_count?, max_follow_ups_per_question?, answer_time_limit_sec?, think_time_sec? }. Nhom-3 defaults when omitted: main_question_count=3, max_follow_ups_per_question=2, answer_time_limit_sec=120, think_time_sec=0. Ranges (inclusive, else 400 VALIDATION_ERROR): main_question_count 1..10, max_follow_ups_per_question 0..5, answer_time_limit_sec 10..600, think_time_sec 0..300. Response 201 = the raw exam_session row (snake_case): { exam_session_id, subject_id, topic_id, title, language, main_question_count, max_follow_ups_per_question, answer_time_limit_sec, think_time_sec, opens_at, closes_at, status ('DRAFT'), created_by, created_at }.
GET /exam-sessions/:id response 200 = session row PLUS { students: [{ exam_session_student_id, exam_session_id, student_id }], examiners: [{ exam_session_examiner_id, exam_session_id, lecturer_id }] } (findByIdWithParticipants).
GET /exam-sessions response 200 = array of raw session rows.
PUT /exam-sessions/:id request: any subset of { title, language, main_question_count, max_follow_ups_per_question, answer_time_limit_sec, think_time_sec }; DRAFT-only (409 INVALID_STATE otherwise); re-validated. Response 200 = updated row.
PUT /exam-sessions/:id/students request: { codes } where codes is a pasted string (split on newlines/commas, trimmed, blanks dropped, deduped) OR a string[]. Success 200 = { ok:true, students:[{ id, code }] }. On ANY invalid row NOTHING is written and the controller returns HTTP 422 (mirrors the question import 422 shape).
PUT /exam-sessions/:id/examiners request: { lecturerIds:int[] } (each must resolve to role LECTURER else 400 VALIDATION_ERROR). Response 200 = { ok:true, examiners:int[] }.
POST /exam-sessions/:id/open response 200 = session row with status 'OPEN' and opens_at set. POST /exam-sessions/:id/close response 200 = row with status 'CLOSED' and closes_at set.

--- The 422 roster error shape (exact) ---
HTTP 422, body: { ok: false, errors: [ { code: <the offending pasted code string>, error: <human message> } ] }. Unknown code -> error 'Unknown student code.'; a resolvable code whose user role !== 'STUDENT' -> error 'Code does not belong to a STUDENT.' All-or-nothing: if errors.length > 0, exam_session_student is left completely untouched (zero writes). Error objects are keyed by `code` (string), NOT by row index.

--- Error codes surfaced ---
400 VALIDATION_ERROR (bad language / out-of-range config / non-LECTURER examiner / missing ids), 403 FORBIDDEN (lecturer out of subject scope), 404 NOT_FOUND / TOPIC_NOT_FOUND, 409 INVALID_STATE (edit non-DRAFT), 409 INVALID_TRANSITION (illegal open/close), 409 NOT_ENOUGH_QUESTIONS (open with < main_question_count APPROVED questions in topic).

--- Reusable picker + lock + TTS (for Steps 6-9) ---
ExamSessionService.pickMainQuestions(topicId, count) returns a random `count`-subset of APPROVED question ids in the topic (Fisher-Yates; exported for Steps 6-7, do NOT build the interview engine here). open() LOCKS every rubric used by the picked APPROVED questions via rubricRepository.setLocked(rubricId, true, tx) (new method added; wires the previously-unreachable Step-3 lock) and the status flip + locks run inside db.withTransaction when available. open() pre-generates audio by calling ttsAdapter.synthesize({text, language}) once per picked main question (mock seam only; NO network). Repository additions on examSessionRepository: update(allowlist), listByCreator, listBySubjectIds, findByIdWithParticipants, setStudents/setExaminers (transactional delete-all+insert), countApprovedQuestionsInTopic, listApprovedQuestionIdsInTopic.

--- IMPORTANT for FEAT-003 (mock-DB caveat) ---
The in-memory mock DB does NOT model exam_session SQL, so exam-session UNIT tests must use injected fakes (see test/examSessionService.test.js FakeExamSessionRepo) and any offline e2e must stay off the exam-session repo. The real exam-session SQL (and the rubric-lock/open flow) is exercised ONLY by the Postgres-gated describe in test/examSessions.e2e.test.js (self-skips without TEST_DATABASE_URL).
